summary: STATUS — OCTOBER 2, 2026: Most principal looks are assembled; finish remaining assembly. No fittings have started. Use confirmed rehearsal hours only. Classroom fitting space confirmed; up to two stations. Target 5 minutes per performer, maximum 10; reserve 10-minute slots (12/hour with two stations; 6/hour with one). Oct. 8 rotations approved; station staffing and final cast list remain pending. Oct. 7 roster and Oct. 10 time/access issues remain unresolved.
fittingPolicy: CLASSROOMS — SPACE AND ROTATIONS APPROVED. Up to two stations; target 5 minutes per performer, maximum 10, in reserved 10-minute slots. Oct. 8: 22 called dancers, 6:30–8:20 PM; buffer 8:20–8:30. Station staffing, ready costumes and final cast list remain to be settled. Keep captains available and return each pair promptly. If only one station is staffed, fit 11 in 110 minutes; move the rest to their next called date.
